summary: After a large language model (LLM) agent generates an artifact, users often send edit requests for it. This paper studies whether an LLM can anticipate these requests before they are sent.
takeaways: We formalize this task as edit recommendation and build EditRecBench, a benchmark for evaluating the performance of LLMs on this task, from real-world conversation logs in WildChat-4.8M.
This paper studies whether an LLM can anticipate these requests before they are sent.
To address this, we introduce decision model-based gating to filter out cases where predictions are unlikely to be correct before they are presented to the user.
